title: Tofu compaction receipt v1
description: Bounded archive/API inspection metadata, capped at 32 KiB by storage. Never a summary body, transcript, proof of provider delivery, empirical speed/cost improvement, or subscription charge. Legacy archives may have an empty receipt instead. Additive fields absent in older v1 receipts mean unknown, never zero, complete, adopted, or free.

resumeWitness.description: Optional executor-produced guard for reusing the archive's accepted postMessages. Reuse requires fresh owner-scoped history, policy, background and tool-prefix validation; this receipt never replaces transcript authority. A Continue attempt may differ from the archive attempt. Fresh non-tool messages must follow a proven unchanged input baseline and be preserved after accepted execution; an unproven baseline or media falls back to canonical replay.

continuityDigest.description: Integrity of the source-derived continuation packet; does not certify narrative semantics.

continuation.description: Automatic context_handoff phase/placement additionally follows compaction_handoff_v1.schema.json; metadata does not prove dispatch.

generated.description: A usable summary was produced; false does not prove no paid attempt occurred.

complete.description: Verified complete output, independent of adoption. Explicitly incomplete output must never be presented as usable summary text. Absent on legacy receipts means unknown, not generated/accepted.

accepted.description: Adopted into the compaction result, not provider acceptance. A complete economic candidate may still be rejected.

durationMs.description: Observed duration, not a summary deadline or latency improvement.

projectedUsageTokens.description: Pre-call usage estimate, not observed billing or a physical prompt limit.

attempts.description: At most three recorded summary routes, separate from transport retries and cost.calls. Missing attempts or providerReached means unknown, not no call or no ingress. No credential identifiers, source references, exception text or prompt material.

contextBudget.description: Recorded main-route admission/decision evidence, not the summary route. Optional snapshots need not describe the post-compaction provider request. Missing values stay unknown; clients must not infer admission from the economic target or archived token reduction.

hardCeilingTokens.description: Physical prompt safety ceiling after output/safety reserve.

reserveTokens.description: max(0, routeWindowTokens - hardCeilingTokens), only when both were recorded.

windowSafetyTokens.description: Window-policy safety ceiling before the resolved output reservation is intersected.

requestedOutputTokens.description: Explicit configured output cap, or null when the model default was requested.

resolvedOutputTokens.description: Resolved output allowance; reserveTokens also includes safety headroom and is not this allowance.

outputReservationPolicy.description: input_aware_output_cap or native_bound_reservation; recorded evidence only.

economicTargetTokens.description: Optional economic target, never an alternate physical context limit.

renderedPromptTokens.description: Recorded complete rendered prompt including non-message overhead, not archive tokensAfter.

decisionKind.description: Known values: safety, economic, manual. Empty/future values display as unknown, never as a translation key.

economics.description: Modeled economics, not measured money saved. Display a payback estimate only with pricingKnown=true and finite nonnegative paybackRounds; explicit null then means no finite estimate, while absent/invalid values stay unknown. Missing/false pricingKnown cannot prove payback. Partial known components may coexist with unknown total costs.

summaryCostTokens.description: Legacy token-domain work estimate, never USD; null means unavailable.

amount.description: Finite nonnegative value or null for unknown/unavailable; missing is not zero.

usage.description: Normalized counters may be zero when provider usage is absent; they alone never establish known billing.

summaryAuthIssue.description: Allowlisted typed subscription-source availability reasons only. Account/owner/reference/source-binding conflicts, sign-in expiry, untyped exception text and local payload defects are not availability evidence.

summaryFailure.description: Safe summary-owner failure diagnostics. Generic display causes never certify credential availability or provider ingress; the credential variant retains its strict unsent evidence. Missing facts remain unknown.

summaryDisplayFailure.description: Content-free display diagnostics only. Optional HTTP status and dispatcher request-count/limit facts come from genuine typed exception evidence, not route counts or selected cost rows. This introduces no summary retry limit and never authorizes fallback, source deletion or credential recovery.

summaryCredentialFailure.description: Executor-validated current keyed summary failure before any summary-provider ingress. Absent on older receipts means unknown. This metadata neither proves main-provider delivery nor authorizes credential rebinding, fallback or source deletion.

providerReached.description: Recorded ingress evidence, not inferred from an exception's message. Omitted means unknown.

providerId.description: Native auxiliary plans record the actual selected Provider; legacy plans may record an execution-group pin. Per-call actual dispatch identities are recorded in summary.cost.calls.

costBasis.description: Bounded diagnostic serialization of selection-time pricing evidence. Unlike summary.cost.costBasis, this is not a billing-basis enum or proof of known spend; clients must not parse it as price evidence.

route.description: Recorded summary-selection route, never inferred from archive.model/taskModel. Per-call dispatch identities live in summary.cost.calls (bounded to 16), which may include retries/failures on different routes.

summarySelection.description: Optional selection-time evidence: exact AA, maintained declarations, or confirmed text-route admission with null quality score. Eligibility is compiler-owned, independent of provider/family and optional benchmark coverage. Never measured summary fidelity, latency or subscription cash savings.

knownCostUsd.description: Subtotal of known attempts only, never a substitute for an unknown full cost.

pricingSnapshot.description: Call-time route, currency, tier and rate evidence owned by the shared billing contract.

summaryCost.description: Metered API-equivalent cost of all recorded attempts, including rejected/failed work. Known total requires complete usage and price evidence for every attempt. A nonzero cost below display precision must not be rendered as free.
